title: Business Architecture Principles Catalogue
description: Catalogue of architecture principles for the Business architecture domain — vendor-neutral guidelines that shape design decisions. Aligned to TOGAF Architecture Principles (Name, Statement, Rationale, Implications).

meta.description: The guiding principles that shape how Business architecture decisions are made.
purpose: Provides consistent decision-making criteria across teams and time
Ensures individual decisions are coherent with the organisation's direction
Reduces architectural drift by making the rules explicit and traceable
Enables automated analysis of new decisions against established principles
Builds a body of architectural wisdom that accumulates over time

$schema.description: URN of the schema this instance conforms to (this file's $id).

statement.description: The principle, stated as a directive

rationale.description: Why this principle exists — the underlying motivation

implications.description: Consequences for design and decision-making if this principle is adopted
